evals.prompt: Send 10000 satoshis to tb1qw508d6qejxtdg4y5r3zarvary0c5xw7kxpjzsx on Bitcoin testnet using my Turnkey wallet with signTransaction. I have a P2WPKH (SegWit) address.
evals.expected_output: Working TypeScript code that initializes Turnkey sdk-server client and bitcoinjs-lib with tiny-secp256k1, fetches UTXOs from a block explorer API, builds a PSBT with P2WPKH inputs (using nonWitnessUtxo and witnessUtxo via bitcoin.payments.p2wpkh), calls client.signTransaction with type TRANSACTION_TYPE_BITCOIN, then finalizes the PSBT with finalizeAllInputs and extracts the transaction.

evals.prompt: Send BTC using my Turnkey wallet with a Taproot (P2TR) address on testnet. Use signTransaction.
evals.expected_output: Working TypeScript code that builds a PSBT with P2TR inputs using tapInternalKey (x-only 32-byte key derived from compressed public key) and bitcoin.payments.p2tr for witnessUtxo. Calls client.signTransaction with TRANSACTION_TYPE_BITCOIN, finalizes and extracts.

evals.prompt: I need per-input signing control for my Bitcoin transaction. Sign a P2WPKH PSBT using signRawPayload with a custom signer class.
evals.expected_output: Code that defines a TurnkeySigner class with a sign() method that calls client.signRawPayload with HASH_FUNCTION_NO_OP and PAYLOAD_ENCODING_HEXADECIMAL. Builds a PSBT, then signs each input via psbt.signInputAsync(i, signer). Does NOT use signTransaction or TRANSACTION_TYPE_BITCOIN.

evals.prompt: Send 0.001 BTC to tb1qw508d6qejxtdg4y5r3zarvary0c5xw7kxpjzsx using my Turnkey Ethereum signer from @turnkey/ethers.
evals.expected_output: The code should use bitcoinjs-lib and the Turnkey signTransaction API, NOT @turnkey/ethers or @turnkey/viem or @turnkey/solana. Even though the user mentioned their 'Ethereum signer', Bitcoin transactions require bitcoinjs-lib with PSBT construction.

evals.prompt: Send BTC on Bitcoin mainnet using signTransaction with a P2WPKH address. My address starts with bc1q.
evals.expected_output: Code that uses bitcoin.networks.bitcoin (mainnet) instead of testnet. Uses mainnet Blockstream API (blockstream.info/api, not /testnet). The address format should be bc1q... (mainnet P2WPKH). Calls signTransaction with TRANSACTION_TYPE_BITCOIN.

evals.prompt: I don't have a Bitcoin wallet yet. Create a wallet with a Bitcoin SegWit account and then sign a transaction to send 5000 sats to tb1qw508d6qejxtdg4y5r3zarvary0c5xw7kxpjzsx on testnet.
evals.expected_output: Code that first calls getWallets to check for existing wallets, then createWallet with CURVE_SECP256K1 accounts for both ADDRESS_FORMAT_BITCOIN_MAINNET_P2WPKH (or testnet equivalent) and ADDRESS_FORMAT_COMPRESSED. Then proceeds to build and sign a PSBT using the derived address and compressed public key.
